about: Points in checks and titles count from 1 as on screen; in measure, index counts from 0 as the engine does (screen point 10 is index 9). Traffic Sim cross-check against the T-6 manuals (task 24, part 1). Numbers and page references only: the manuals are private. Each scenario names the manual number, its unit and page, the tolerance and how it is measured in the built-in Moose Jaw setup (moose-jaw.json, seed 1). tests/crosscheck/traffic-scenarios.test.js flies them and compares the table with tests/crosscheck/traffic-expected.json. It only reports: nothing here changes a number in the engine or the setup.

modes.within: sim value must be within the tolerance of the manual number
modes.atLeast: sim value must be at least the manual number, less the tolerance
modes.atMost: sim value must be at most the manual number, plus the tolerance
modes.info: no manual number to compare with: the sim value is shown for a pilot to judge
modes.overridden: the manual number as printed, which Patrick has overridden: shown so the difference is visible, not judged
modes.waits: the setup cannot express this yet: waits on the task named in waitsOn

sources.patrick: Patrick's logged answer, which wins over the manual (questions-for-patrick.md, decisions)
sources.derived: worked out from a manual number with core's flight math or T-6A model
sources.spec: SPEC-traffic (a setting Patrick chose, not a manual number)

scenarios.title: Harvard pattern height (upwind to downwind after the break)
scenarios.checks: Lowest height over Pattern 1 points 4 to 12, the outer pattern, initial, break and downwind.
scenarios.measure: min of route.points[3..11].alt on PAT1
scenarios.note: Patrick kept 3,500 ft. The manuals print 3,000 (next row).

scenarios.title: Harvard pattern height as the manuals print it
scenarios.checks: Same height as the row above, against the printed manual number that Patrick overrode.
scenarios.measure: same as h-pattern-height

scenarios.title: Closed pattern level-off height
scenarios.checks: Height where the closed-pattern split (Split 3) rejoins downwind.
scenarios.measure: SPL3 last point .alt
scenarios.note: The closed pattern levels at pattern height, so it follows Patrick's 3,500.

scenarios.title: Straight-in base leg height
scenarios.checks: Height of the level straight-in base leg (Split 1).
scenarios.page: SMM 4.5 para 8; EFIG p.131; Patrick Q3 (05:03Z)
scenarios.measure: SPL1 route.points[2].alt

scenarios.title: Descent from pattern height to the straight-in base
scenarios.checks: How far below the pattern the straight-in base sits (Split 1: 3,500 to 2,700).
scenarios.measure: PAT1 pattern height minus SPL1 route.points[2].alt
scenarios.note: The manual says 300 ft below the pattern (2,700 from a 3,000 pattern). Patrick flies a 3,500 pattern and the 2,700 base (Q3, 05:04Z), so the drop is 800 ft.

scenarios.title: Height at the window (3/4 NM out on final, Pattern 1)
scenarios.checks: Height on final 4,557 ft (0.75 NM) before the threshold.
scenarios.measure: positionAt(PAT1, lengthFt - 0.75 NM).alt
scenarios.note: The manual gives about 2,100 to 2,200 ft; 2,150 is the middle.

scenarios.title: Height at the window (3/4 NM out on final, Split 1 straight-in)
scenarios.checks: Height on final 4,557 ft (0.75 NM) before the threshold, along Split 1.
scenarios.measure: positionAt(SPL1, lengthFt - 0.75 NM).alt

scenarios.title: Height at the window (3/4 NM out on final, Entry 2 straight-in)
scenarios.checks: Height on final 4,557 ft (0.75 NM) before the threshold, along Entry 2.
scenarios.measure: positionAt(ENT2, lengthFt - 0.75 NM).alt

scenarios.title: Grob pattern height
scenarios.checks: The Grob flies its own closer pattern at 3,000 ft and 180 KIAS.
scenarios.measure: not expressible: the built-in setup has one pattern, and an aircraft type is only a colour (task 11 gives types their own speeds, task 14 adds the Grob pattern)

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Pattern 1 (last point to threshold)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the leg from the last route point before the threshold to the threshold, Pattern 1.
scenarios.measure: atan((alt[12] - alt[0]) / leg 13 to 1 length), PAT1

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Pattern 1 (flown, from the roll-out)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the last straight bit of the flown path, from where the last turn rolls out to the threshold. The row above measures from the corner point, which is further out than the roll-out.
scenarios.measure: atan(height drop / length) of the last straight bit of the flown path (routePath segs)

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Split 1 straight-in (last point to threshold)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the leg from the last route point before the threshold to the threshold, Split 1.
scenarios.measure: atan(height drop / length) of the leg from the last route point before the threshold, SPL1

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Split 1 straight-in (flown, from the roll-out)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the last straight bit of the flown path, from where the last turn rolls out to the threshold. The row above measures from the corner point, which is further out than the roll-out.
scenarios.measure: atan(height drop / length) of the last straight bit of the flown path (routePath segs)

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Entry 2 straight-in (last point to threshold)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the leg from the last route point before the threshold to the threshold, Entry 2.
scenarios.measure: atan(height drop / length) of the leg from the last route point before the threshold, ENT2

scenarios.title: Glide angle on final, Entry 2 straight-in (flown, from the roll-out)
scenarios.checks: Angle over the last straight bit of the flown path, from where the last turn rolls out to the threshold. The row above measures from the corner point, which is further out than the roll-out.
scenarios.measure: atan(height drop / length) of the last straight bit of the flown path (routePath segs)

scenarios.title: Pattern and initial speed
scenarios.checks: Lowest speed set on Pattern 1 points 4 to 10 (upwind to the break).
scenarios.page: SMM 4.14 para 32; EFIG p.212, p.151, p.185
scenarios.measure: min of route.points[3..9].kt on PAT1

scenarios.title: Speed at the end of the break
scenarios.checks: Speed set where the break rolls out on downwind (must be below the gear limit).
scenarios.measure: PAT1 route.points[10].kt

scenarios.title: Downwind speed at the perch
scenarios.checks: Speed set at the end of downwind.
scenarios.measure: PAT1 route.points[11].kt

scenarios.title: Slowest speed in the final turn
scenarios.checks: Lowest speed set on the two final-turn corners (points 12 and 13).
scenarios.measure: min of PAT1 route.points[11..12].kt
scenarios.note: The manual's floor is the threshold crossing speed plus 10 kt.

scenarios.title: Speed at the window
scenarios.checks: Speed set at the last pattern point before the threshold.
scenarios.page: SMM 4.1 para 1, 4.8 para 13, Table 4.1; Patrick Q2 (05:03Z)
scenarios.measure: PAT1 route.points[12].kt
scenarios.note: SPEC-traffic reads Patrick's answer as a gradual slow-down from 120 at the window to 100 at the threshold.

scenarios.title: Speed at the threshold
scenarios.checks: Landing speed set at the threshold point.
scenarios.measure: PAT1 route.points[0].kt

scenarios.title: Straight-in speed at the base turn
scenarios.checks: Speed set at the base-turn point of Split 1.
scenarios.measure: SPL1 route.points[2].kt

scenarios.title: Straight-in speed at the final turn
scenarios.checks: Lowest speed on the two corners after base on Split 1.
scenarios.measure: min of SPL1 route.points[3..4].kt

scenarios.title: Closed pattern speed
scenarios.checks: Lowest speed set on the closed-pattern split (Split 3).
scenarios.measure: min of SPL3 points .kt
scenarios.note: The manual's number is a minimum.

scenarios.title: 220 KIAS at 3,500 ft, as a true speed
scenarios.checks: The sim flies the route's number as ground speed with no wind. 220 KIAS at 3,500 ft is a faster true speed.
scenarios.page: SMM 4.14 para 32 (220 KIAS) with core iasToTasKt at 3,500 ft
scenarios.measure: sim speed on the outer pattern, against iasToTasKt(220, 3500)

scenarios.title: 120 KIAS at 3,500 ft, as a true speed
scenarios.checks: Same for the downwind after the break.
scenarios.page: SMM 4.17 para 41 (120 KIAS) with core iasToTasKt at 3,500 ft
scenarios.measure: sim speed at the perch point, against iasToTasKt(120, 3500)

scenarios.title: Pattern corner bank (G asked at the corner)
scenarios.checks: Lowest bank asked at the big pattern corners (points 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10).
scenarios.measure: min of pointTurn(PAT1, i).bankDeg for index i = 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9

scenarios.title: Break, first half: bank asked
scenarios.checks: Bank asked at the first break corner (point 10).
scenarios.measure: pointTurn(PAT1, 9).bankDeg

scenarios.title: Break, second half: bank asked
scenarios.checks: Bank asked at the second break corner (point 11), where the speed is 140 kt and the G is set to 1.
scenarios.measure: pointTurn(PAT1, 10).bankDeg

scenarios.title: Break, first half: peak bank actually flown
scenarios.checks: The turn is cut short by the legs on each side and flown as a curve that is tightest in the middle. Peak bank on the flown path at the first break corner.
scenarios.measure: peak bank on the flown path: max over the turn of atan(v squared * curvature / g), curvature from the heading change per path length (routePath), v the point speed

scenarios.title: Break, second half: peak bank actually flown
scenarios.checks: Same measure at the second break corner.
scenarios.measure: peak bank on the flown path at PAT1 index 10

scenarios.title: Break: total heading change
scenarios.checks: Turn from the initial track to the downwind track.
scenarios.measure: heading of the initial leg minus heading of the downwind leg, from routePath segs

scenarios.title: Break: height change (level turn)
scenarios.checks: Height lost between the start of the break and downwind.
scenarios.measure: alt[9] minus alt[10] on PAT1

scenarios.title: Final turn: bank asked
scenarios.checks: Highest bank asked at the two final-turn corners, where the G is set to 1.
scenarios.page: SMM 4.19 para 43; EFIG p.150-152; Patrick Q3
scenarios.measure: max of pointTurn(PAT1, 11..12).bankDeg

scenarios.title: Final turn: peak bank actually flown
scenarios.checks: The same two corners, read off the shape actually flown. The manual says up to 45.
scenarios.measure: max peak bank on the flown path at PAT1 index 11 and 12

scenarios.title: Final turn: total heading change
scenarios.checks: Turn from downwind to the final track.
scenarios.measure: heading of the downwind leg minus heading of the final leg

scenarios.title: Final turn: straight bit in the middle
scenarios.checks: The manual's final turn is one continuous descending 180 degrees. Pattern 1 flies two corners with a short straight (the base leg) between them.
scenarios.measure: length of the straight part of the leg between the two final-turn corners, from routePath segs

scenarios.title: Straight-in turns: bank asked
scenarios.checks: Highest bank asked at the three corners of Split 1 (onto base, onto the 45-degree leg and onto final).
scenarios.page: SMM 4.6 para 9, 4.16 para 36; EFIG p.131; Patrick Q3 (05:04Z)
scenarios.measure: max of pointTurn(SPL1, i).bankDeg for the corners, index 2, 3, 4

scenarios.title: Corners: G asked against the G the aircraft can pull
scenarios.checks: Worst corner on any route: G set at the corner minus the G the T-6A can pull at that speed (stall line). Zero or less is fine.
scenarios.page: core T6A_LIMITS (stall 86 KIAS, Patrick 09:29Z); NFM Fig 6-3, V-n
scenarios.measure: max over every route corner of (g - availableG(kt)), speed read as KIAS

scenarios.title: Corners: G actually flown against the G the aircraft can pull
scenarios.checks: Worst corner on any route: the G the flown curve needs at its tightest (from the peak bank) minus the G the T-6A can pull at that speed. Zero or less is fine.
scenarios.page: core T6A_LIMITS (stall 86 KIAS, Patrick 09:29Z); NFM Fig 6-3, V-n
scenarios.measure: max over every route corner of (1 / cos(peak bank) - availableG(kt)), speed read as KIAS

scenarios.title: Initial: heading against the runway
scenarios.checks: Heading of the straight initial leg minus the runway heading (threshold to departure end).
scenarios.measure: heading of the initial leg (routePath) minus runway heading from PAT1 points 1 and 2

scenarios.title: Initial: sideways offset from the extended centreline
scenarios.checks: Sideways distance of the initial leg's end (the break point) from the centreline.
scenarios.measure: cross-track distance of PAT1 index 9 from the runway line

scenarios.title: Final: heading against the runway
scenarios.checks: Heading of the final leg minus the runway heading.
scenarios.measure: heading of the last leg of PAT1 minus runway heading

scenarios.title: Downwind: parallel to the runway
scenarios.checks: Downwind heading minus the runway's reciprocal.
scenarios.measure: heading of the straight downwind leg minus (runway heading + 180)

scenarios.title: Downwind: distance from the runway centreline
scenarios.checks: Sideways distance of the downwind leg. The manual gives a visual reference only, no distance; the least spacing a 180-degree turn at 45 degrees of bank and 120 KIAS (126.4 kt true at 3,500 ft) allows is worked out from the manual's 45-degree limit.
scenarios.page: SMM 4.19 para 43 (45 deg limit) with core turnRadiusFt at 120 KIAS as true speed; EFIG p.134, p.183 (visual reference only)
scenarios.measure: mean cross-track distance of the ends of the straight downwind leg from the runway line

scenarios.title: Downwind leg length (break to perch)
scenarios.checks: Length between the downwind points (11 to 12 on screen), the Leg distances figure. The manual gives no number.
scenarios.page: no number in the manuals (SMM Fig 4.9, EFIG p.211 are diagrams)
scenarios.measure: legDistances(PAT1) leg 11 to 12, .ft

scenarios.title: Break point: distance past the threshold
scenarios.checks: Where the break starts, along the runway from the threshold, with no wind. The manual says about 2,000 ft with a 10 kt headwind and earlier with less wind, so the no-wind break should be at or before 2,000 ft.
scenarios.measure: along-runway distance of the start of the rounded turn at PAT1 index 9
scenarios.note: At most 2,000 ft for the no-wind case.

scenarios.title: Break roll-out: before abeam the threshold
scenarios.checks: Along-runway distance of the break roll-out, past the threshold (must not be short of it).
scenarios.measure: along-runway distance of the end of the rounded turn at PAT1 index 10

scenarios.title: Perch: distance before the threshold
scenarios.checks: Where the final turn starts, measured back from the threshold. The manual starts it abeam the window.
scenarios.measure: along-runway distance of the start of the rounded turn at PAT1 index 11, before the threshold

scenarios.title: Final turn roll-out: distance before the threshold
scenarios.checks: Where the final turn rolls out on the centreline. The manual rolls out through the window.
scenarios.measure: along-runway distance of the end of the rounded turn at PAT1 index 12, before the threshold

scenarios.title: Spacing on final: closest two aircraft at the threshold
scenarios.checks: Fly the built-in traffic for an hour; the shortest gap between two aircraft crossing the threshold, in feet at 100 kt. There is no extension in the engine yet.
scenarios.page: SPEC-traffic T11 (Patrick, 07:20Z); EFIG p.393 gives 2,000 for stream landing
scenarios.measure: createSim(moose-jaw, seed 1), 3,600 s sampled every 0.25 s; crossing times of the threshold line interpolated; gap seconds times 100 kt

scenarios.title: Time from the break to the perch
scenarios.checks: Time from the start of the break to the start of the final turn.
scenarios.measure: one aircraft on PAT1 (landOdds 0), sim time between the distances where the rounded turns at PAT1 index 9 and index 11 start

scenarios.title: Distance flown from the break to the perch
scenarios.checks: Ground track length from the start of the break to the start of the final turn.
scenarios.measure: pointDistFt(PAT1, 11) minus pointDistFt(PAT1, 9)

scenarios.title: Time in the final turn
scenarios.checks: Time from the start of the final turn to its roll-out.
scenarios.measure: sim time from the start of the rounded turn at PAT1 index 11 to the end of the one at index 12

scenarios.title: Time from initial to the threshold
scenarios.checks: Time from the start of the turn onto initial to the threshold, the whole overhead-break circuit.
scenarios.measure: one aircraft on PAT1 (landOdds 0) started at index 8, to the end of the lap

scenarios.title: Time round the whole Pattern 1 loop
scenarios.checks: Time for one lap of the whole loop from the threshold, outer pattern included.
scenarios.measure: one aircraft on PAT1 (landOdds 0) from the threshold to the end of the lap

scenarios.title: Closed pattern: time from the departure end to downwind
scenarios.checks: Time for the closed-pattern split (Split 3) from its start to where it rejoins downwind.
scenarios.page: no number in the manuals (fuel about 15 lb, SMM 4.3 para 4)
scenarios.measure: one aircraft started on SPL3 until it joins PAT1

scenarios.title: Break point moves with the wind
scenarios.checks: Later with a strong headwind, earlier with a light one.
scenarios.unit: ft past threshold at 10 kt headwind
scenarios.measure: no wind and no break rule in the engine yet (tasks 10 and 15)

scenarios.title: Slowing from 220 to 120 KIAS through the break
scenarios.checks: Idle power in the break, then about 35 percent torque on downwind.
scenarios.measure: the engine blends the route's speeds along the leg; the break's own deceleration comes with task 15

scenarios.title: Continuous descending 180-degree final turn
scenarios.checks: One turn from the perch to the window at up to 45 degrees of bank and 120 KIAS, rolling out on the 3-degree glide path.
scenarios.measure: Pattern 1 flies it as two corners; the true turn comes with task 15 (the corner rows above show today's shape)

scenarios.title: Perch moves with the wind
scenarios.checks: Along the runway for headwind, sideways for crosswind.
scenarios.measure: no wind in the engine yet (tasks 10 and 15)

scenarios.title: PFL High Key height
scenarios.checks: High Key at Moose Jaw.
scenarios.measure: no PFL route in the engine yet

scenarios.title: PFL Low Key height
scenarios.checks: Low Key, 180 degrees round from High Key.
scenarios.measure: no PFL route in the engine yet

scenarios.title: PFL Final Key height
scenarios.checks: Final Key, 270 degrees round from High Key.
scenarios.measure: no PFL route in the engine yet
scenarios.note: SPEC-traffic says about 3,050; the manual says 3,000.

scenarios.title: PFL height lost in a full circle
scenarios.checks: 360 degrees at 120 KIAS, 30 degrees of bank, gear down.
scenarios.measure: no PFL route in the engine yet

scenarios.title: PFL circle diameter
scenarios.checks: The forced-landing pattern is a descending circle about 1 NM across.
scenarios.measure: no PFL route in the engine yet

scenarios.title: Engine-out zoom and glide
scenarios.checks: Zoom then glide by configuration. Core's thread runs the glide and zoom scenarios; this row waits for the sim to use them.
scenarios.measure: no engine-out in the engine yet

scenarios.title: Extending downwind for traffic on final
scenarios.checks: The roll-out is held back until it is at least the final spacing behind the aircraft ahead.
scenarios.measure: no extension logic in the engine yet; the spacing row above shows what the setup gives without it

scenarios.title: Minimum landing spacing for a stream landing
scenarios.checks: Formation stream landing.
scenarios.measure: needs traffic on final (task 18)
